name: Wall of Darkness
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You create a wall of magical darkness within medium range that is 10 ft high, 5 ft thick, and up to 30 ft long or a circular wall with a diameter of short range. Uncheck any number of Conditions and roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Each creature that enters the wall, begins its turn adjacent to the wall, moves into a space adjacent to the wall, or is within the wall when it's created must roll Strength against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature takes 1d4 damage, is grappled by the wall, and is pulled into the wall if it's not already within it. A creature grappled by the wall rolls against the Difficulty to escape. On a pass, it takes half damage and is pushed out of or away from the wall in a direction it chooses.

For each Condition you unchecked (twice for Afraid), choose one:

  • The wall becomes 10 ft longer or taller, or the diameter increases by 10 ft.

  • +1d damage.

  • Whenever you maintain concentration for this spell, you may move the wall or part of the wall an additional 5 ft in any direction you choose.

Describe how you create the wall.
successes:
✨: Each time a creature attempts escape the wall's grapple and fails, it takes an additional 1d4 damage.

🌞: The wall gains a Reach of 5.
